questions.q: How many faces does a cube have?
questions.why: Top, bottom, front, back, left and right: 6 faces.

questions.q: How many vertices (corners) does a cube have?
questions.why: 4 corners on top and 4 on the bottom: 8.

questions.q: How many edges does a cube have?
questions.why: 4 on top, 4 on the bottom and 4 going up: 12.

questions.q: How many faces does a triangular prism have?
questions.why: 2 triangles and 3 rectangles: 5 faces.

questions.q: How many edges does a triangular prism have?
questions.why: 3 on each triangle end (6) and 3 joining them: 9.

questions.q: How many vertices does a square pyramid have?
questions.why: 4 corners on the base and 1 at the top: 5.

questions.q: How many edges does a square pyramid have?
questions.why: 4 around the base and 4 going up to the top: 8.
